title: Slot run result
description: What a slot run leaves in .slot/out/result.json for its runner. The runner validates it before anything is recorded.

unit.description: The work unit this run was started for.

outcome.description: done: the unit's work is on its branch. blocked: the run needs an answer. failed: the run could not do the work.

head.description: The commit the unit's branch ends at in the run's clone. Required for outcome done.

summary.description: What the run did, in a few lines.

evidence.description: Files under .slot/out/evidence/ with their SHA-256 and line count.

questions.description: Decisions or facts the run needs, one line each, in the DECISION or ASK form.
